baseline.evidence_scope: Frozen synthetic grid navigation; no teacher assistance or training. No-graft and no-recurrence are inference-time interventions on identical weights, not separately trained baselines. Random is seeded; shortest_path has full-map access. Declared seeds are not proof of unseen training worlds. SPL counts successful cell moves; collisions and attempted steps are separate. Teacher agreement uses one deterministic shortest-path tie-break. No biological advantage or pretrained language capability established. Readout control: no_graft retains the direct all-source readout in context_residual mode. no_context bypasses only the context residual readout when present; legacy human readout is unchanged. This is an inference-time intervention on identical weights, not a training comparison or evidence of learning.
